patient_identity.statement: Single Maltese-Caucasian male patient examined at age3, matching packet. Disease skin onset two weeks after birth matches P14D.

evidence.locator: Clinical presentation paragraphs 1-3

genotype.statement: Homozygous SPINK5 c.2015+5G>A is supported by sequencing Figure2; source uses NM_001127698.1 and GRCh37 chr5:147494057, whereas packet uses NM_006846.4 and hg38:148114494.

evidence.locator: Genetic analysis; Figures 2-3

limitations: Transcript/build translation not independently demonstrated in paper; p.? appropriately preserves unmeasured splice product.

segregation.statement: Both nonconsanguineous parents and older sibling carry the variant heterozygously on bidirectional Sanger; child homozygous.

evidence.locator: Genetic analysis and Figure3 father/mother/sibling chromatograms

phase.statement: Homozygosity with both parents heterozygous supports biallelic parental inheritance; no separate two-variant cis/trans issue.

evidence.locator: Genetic analysis and Figures2-3

limitations: No long-range haplotype or parental identity assay described.

causal_confidence.statement: Paper explicitly classifies c.2015+5G>A as LIKELY PATHOGENIC (PS3,PM2,PP3,PP4); packet upgrades to PATHOGENIC. Loss of LEKTI staining supports attribution but actual aberrant mRNA/splice product was not measured.

evidence.locator: Histology and Immunofluorescence final paragraph; Discussion; Table S1/Figure S1

limitations: Loricrin control addresses general staining concern; computational splicing scores are not observed transcript evidence.

phenotype_completeness.statement: Packet omits hyperIgEemia, multiple IgE-proven food allergies, low length centile and lusterless hair; source also gives negative electrolyte, nail/teeth, vision/hearing and learning/neurological findings.

evidence.locator: Clinical presentation paragraphs 1-3

limitations: No general NS phenotype imported to this patient; older sibling Down syndrome not assigned to proband.
